## QUIZ-GLOBAL-01 — Remove module-attribution phrasing from quiz stems

*Buang atribusi 'yang dinyatakan dalam modul' daripada soalan kuiz*

> Global keseluruhan kursus – buang "yang dinyatakan dalam modul"

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| decision | T04-DEC-E06 |
| scope | ALL_PLS_IN_KURSUS |
| source | AUTH-EV-01 §E, Q1 komen/pindaan |
| applies beyond T04 | yes |
| applied to T04 items | T04-QZ-Q1, T04-QZ-Q2, T04-QZ-Q3, T04-QZ-Q4, T04-QZ-Q5 |
| status | AUTHORITY_ISSUED_COURSE_WIDE |

**Rule.** A quiz stem must ask the question directly. It must not attribute its content to the module — no 'yang dinyatakan dalam modul', no 'mengikut modul', no 'Modul menyenaraikan'.

**Banned phrasing.** `yang dinyatakan dalam modul`, `mengikut modul`, `dalam modul`, `Modul menyenaraikan`

**Enforcement.** Every T04 stem is checked against the banned phrases by a gate. Units outside T04 are out of this stage's scope and are not modified here.

## QUIZ-GLOBAL-02 — Multiple Response options use checkboxes, not letter labels

*Gunakan kotak, bukan A B C, bagi soalan Multiple Response*

> Global keseluruhan kursus. Jangan gunakan A B C .. untuk pilihan, kerana ini ialah multiple response question. Cadangan - Gunakan kotak.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| decision | T04-DEC-E07 |
| scope | ALL_PLS_IN_KURSUS |
| source | AUTH-EV-01 §E, Q5 komen/pindaan |
| applies beyond T04 | yes |
| applied to T04 items | T04-QZ-Q5 |
| status | AUTHORITY_ISSUED_COURSE_WIDE |

**Rule.** A Multiple Response item presents its options as checkboxes. Letter labels A, B, C … are reserved for single-answer items, where they signal that exactly one option is chosen.

**Required option marker.** checkbox · **banned pattern** `^[A-Z]\.\s`

**Enforcement.** A gate asserts no Multiple Response option in T04 carries a letter label, and that all four MCQ items keep theirs.
